sources.observed_facts: All tenant list/get/create/update/status/delete methods guard before accessing tenant rows and emit resolver.CodePlatformPermissionRequired on denial.
Tests cover allowed platform bypass and denial for each tenant CRUD operation after route permissions would have passed.
Defines MULTI_TENANT_PLATFORM_PERMISSION_REQUIRED using default MustDefine key derivation.
MessageKey lowercases and splits underscores, returning error.multi.tenant.platform.permission.required for the defined code.
English error resource contains error.multi.platform.permission.required, missing tenant segment.
Chinese resource has the same different key; full pinned host/plugin JSON scan did not locate the derived key.
